# Lewin Fox

> Lewin Appleton-Fox (Lewin Fox) is a software developer in Queenstown, New Zealand. He builds software to solve business problems: apps, websites, whatever the job needs.

- Most jobs start with something that isn't working, such as a spreadsheet that's got out of hand or a paper form that keeps going missing. What he builds depends on the problem.
- Android and iOS apps, websites and web applications, and tidying up data and reporting.
- Hosting and maintenance once things are live.
- Over ten years in software and data, in finance, government and logistics, in New Zealand and the UK.
- Happy to meet in person in the Queenstown area.
- Every project is quoted individually.

Contact: lewin.a.f@gmail.com
